audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar daily, Sabbath, new-moon, Passover, and Weeks offering calendar, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for continual offerings, Sabbath additions, new-moon offerings, Passover/Unleavened Bread, firstfruits/Weeks, grain and drink measures, and calendar layering.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Command children of Israel and say to them: My offering, my food for my fire-offerings, my soothing scent, you shall keep to bring near to me at its appointed time.

familiar.text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

modern.text: “Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My offerings by fire, as a pleasing aroma to Me.

original.text: צַ֚ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֶת קָרְבָּנִ֨י לַחְמִ֜י לְאִשַּׁ֗י רֵ֚יחַ נִֽיחֹחִ֔י תִּשְׁמְר֕וּ לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִ֖י בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall say to them: This is fire-offering you shall bring near to YHWH—two complete male lambs, sons of a year, each day, as continual burnt offering.

familiar.text: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

modern.text: And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.

original.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם זֶ֚ה הָֽאִשֶּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ לַיהוָ֑ה כְּבָשִׂ֨ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֧ה תְמִימִ֛ם שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם עֹלָ֥ה תָמִֽיד

verses.restored: The one lamb you shall make in morning, and second lamb you shall make between evenings.

familiar.text: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

modern.text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,

original.text: אֶת הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם

verses.restored: And one-tenth ephah fine flour as grain offering, mixed with fourth of a hin beaten oil.

familiar.text: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

modern.text: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.

original.text: וַעֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָאֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְמִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין

verses.restored: It is continual burnt offering ordained at Mount Sinai for soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: עֹלַ֖ת תָּמִ֑יד הָעֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Its drink offering shall be fourth of a hin for one lamb; in holy place pour out strong drink as drink offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

modern.text: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.

original.text: וְנִסְכּוֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַהִ֔ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: The second lamb you shall make between evenings; like grain offering of morning and like its drink offering you shall make it, fire-offering of soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. The Sabbath Offerings

original.text: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: On Sabbath day, two complete male lambs, sons of a year, and two-tenths fine flour mixed with oil as grain offering, and its drink offering.

familiar.text: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

modern.text: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.

original.text: וּבְיוֹם֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת שְׁנֵֽי כְבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ

verses.restored: This is burnt offering of Sabbath on its Sabbath, besides continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

familiar.text: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

modern.text: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering. The Monthly Offerings

original.text: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ עַל עֹלַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְנִסְכָּֽהּ

verses.restored: At beginnings of your months you shall bring near burnt offering to YHWH: two young bulls, one ram, seven complete male lambs, sons of a year;

familiar.text: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

modern.text: At the beginning of every month, you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

original.text: וּבְרָאשֵׁי֙ חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה פָּרִ֨ים בְּנֵֽי בָקָ֤ר שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֔ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם

verses.restored: and three-tenths fine flour mixed with oil as grain offering for each bull, two-tenths fine flour mixed with oil as grain offering for one ram,

familiar.text: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

modern.text: along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram,

original.text: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַפָּ֖ר הָאֶחָ֑ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: and one-tenth fine flour mixed with oil as grain offering for each lamb, a burnt offering of soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד עֹלָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, third of a hin for ram, and fourth of a hin for lamb. This is burnt offering of month in its month throughout months of year.

familiar.text: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

modern.text: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.

original.text: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בְּחָדְשׁ֔וֹ לְחָדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה

verses.restored: One male goat as sin/purification offering to YHWH shall be made besides continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

familiar.text: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

modern.text: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering. Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:14–28; Leviticus 23:4–8; Deuteronomy 16:1–8)

original.text: וּשְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֛ד לְחַטָּ֖את לַיהוָ֑ה עַל עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ

verses.restored: In first month, on fourteenth day of month, is Passover to YHWH.

familiar.text: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.

modern.text: The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.

original.text: וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: On fifteenth day of this month is festival; seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.

familiar.text: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

modern.text: On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.

original.text: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל

verses.restored: On first day shall be holy convocation; no laborious work you shall do.

familiar.text: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

modern.text: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.

original.text: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: You shall bring near fire-offering, burnt offering to YHWH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs, sons of a year; complete they shall be for you.

familiar.text: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

modern.text: Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil; three-tenths for a bull and two-tenths for ram you shall make.

familiar.text: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

modern.text: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,

original.text: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: One-tenth you shall make for each lamb of seven lambs,

familiar.text: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

modern.text: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.

original.text: עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים

verses.restored: and one male goat as sin/purification offering, to make atonement/covering for you.

familiar.text: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

modern.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

original.text: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Besides burnt offering of morning, which is for continual burnt offering, you shall make these.

familiar.text: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

modern.text: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

original.text: מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֑יד תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת אֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Like these you shall make each day seven days, food of fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH; besides continual burnt offering it shall be made, and its drink offering.

familiar.text: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

modern.text: Offer the same food each day for seven days as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.

original.text: כָּאֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה עַל עוֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ

verses.restored: On seventh day holy convocation shall be for you; no laborious work you shall do.

familiar.text: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

modern.text: On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work. The Feast of Weeks (Deuteronomy 16:9–12)

original.text: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: On day of firstfruits, when you bring near new grain offering to YHWH in your Festival of Weeks, holy convocation shall be for you; no laborious work you shall do.

familiar.text: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

modern.text: On the day of firstfruits, when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.

original.text: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: You shall bring near burnt offering for soothing scent to YHWH: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs, sons of a year;

familiar.text: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

modern.text: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old as a pleasing aroma to the LORD,

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה

verses.restored: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for one ram,

familiar.text: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

modern.text: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,

original.text: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֔ד שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: one-tenth for each lamb of seven lambs,

familiar.text: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

modern.text: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.

original.text: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים

verses.restored: and one male goat, to make atonement/covering for you.

familiar.text: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

modern.text: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.

original.text: שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Besides continual burnt offering and its grain offering you shall make them; complete they shall be for you, with their drink offerings.

familiar.text: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

modern.text: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. The animals must be unblemished.

original.text: מִלְּבַ֞ד עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד וּמִנְחָת֖וֹ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיוּ לָכֶ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם

translation_notes: The calendar begins with daily rhythm, then layers Sabbath, new moon, Passover/Unleavened Bread, and Weeks upon the continual offering.
Numbers 28-29 complements Leviticus 23 by specifying sanctuary offerings rather than replacing the festival calendar there.
Passover and Weeks remain Israel's covenantal festivals and living Jewish sacred times; the text must not be Christianized or superseded.
Repeated measures create accountable ritual order, not a hierarchy of spiritual worth.
Animal-sacrifice instructions are source-preserved ancient sanctuary law and are not commands for private or modern reenactment.
safety_note: Do not reenact animal sacrifice, shame people unable to observe ritual schedules, or use this calendar to erase Jewish practice. Receive the chapter as ancient Israelite sanctuary order structured by daily faithfulness, Sabbath, liberation memory, and firstfruits gratitude.
